testing_guidelines.rule: Every button, link, accordion header, modal toggle, and key metric container MUST include data-testid in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Import Outfit & Plus Jakarta Sans via HTML <link> or @import in index.css.
Ensure header/navbar has backdrop-blur-xl and non-transparent dark background (bg-[#030712]/85).
Implement smooth scrolling using Lenis or Framer Motion scroll listeners.
All Telegram buttons must point to 'https://t.me/+ZRXVYah_r0c5ZGU1' and open in target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'.
Ensure mobile responsiveness with hamburger menu or floating CTA bar on small screens.
